messages:
taylor_cs: Auriga sent their vendor form mid-onboarding. They want DPA responses + a one-paragraph KMS attestation + a redacted key-provenance example. Deadline = Thu EOD.
upload-bot: uploaded auriga_vendor_form.pdf (shared)
jasmin_security: I can draft the attestation. Keep Hosted vs Dedicated distinction high level.
andre_dev: suggested wording snippet:
`Hosted: keys managed by Redwood with HSM-backed storage; Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported with integration guidance.`
taylor_cs: also ask about rotation cadence and audit log retention — they specifically asked where logs live.
jasmin_security: draft line: "Keys rotated annually or after suspected compromise; key operations logged to a centralized audit store and retained per our retention policy."
kai_pm: please include a redacted provenance sample (no real ARNs). Short example is fine.
andre_dev: redacted example:
`Alias: redwood-auriga-2025
KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (redacted)
Created: 2024-01-10
LastRotated: 2025-01-10
RotationPolicy: annual`
taylor_cs: perfect. Jasmin, can you paste final attestation here and I'll attach everything to the questionnaire and ask Auriga to confirm sufficiency?
jasmin_security: attestation posted: "Redwood Inference encrypts customer data at rest using HSM-backed key management. For Hosted deployments keys are managed by Redwood; for Dedicated and Private deployments customers may provide BYOK and we provide integration guidance. Keys are rotated annually or on-demand after incidents; rotation and access events are logged to a centralized audit store and retained per our retention policy. Redacted key provenance samples can be provided upon request."
taylor_cs: great — attaching and posting. If they request audit snippets or BYOK we will route to infra/legal for evidence requests. Kai, I'll capture their feedback in the onboarding tracker when they reply. :thumbsup:
